newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's spread over 10-yr Bunds at a record low.
newsitem.headline: Spain's spread over 10-yr Bunds at a record low.

text.p: Spanish bonos' 10-year spread over German bunds hit a record low on Monday.
At about 0910 GMT, the spread widened to 141 bps while in the cash market, the 10-year 8.80 percent benchmark was trading at 110.15, up from 109.90 at Friday's close.
The previous low was set on November 14 at 143 basis points.
The Treasury announced on Monday the new 10-yr bond will have a 7.35-percent coupon, lower than the current benchmark.
The long-term December future was trading at 110.73 from 110.38. Its record high was set at 110.88 on November 15.
